abstract: To assess the tumour aggressiveness of teratoma, clinical records of patients with non-seminomatous germ cell testicular cancer were reviewed. Teratomatous elements were found in 57.8% of tumours. The rate of stage I tumours was lower in the teratoma-positive group than in the teratoma-negative group. Lymph node metastasis occurred more frequently than haematogenous metastasis in the teratoma-positive group. Tumour marker response in metastatic stage of teratoma-positive group was very excellent. Even if the radiographic response was not good, most patients were alive without disease after postchemotherapeutic salvage surgery. Furthermore, two patients with pure teratoma, who had tumour recurrence, were successfully treated with the multimodal therapy. Considering the smaller number of stage I patients in the teratoma-positive group than in the teratoma-negative group, the excellent overall response in the teratoma-positive group showed less aggressiveness of the tumour as a whole.
abstract_ja: 奇形腫成分の侵襲性を評価するため、非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者記録を後ろ向きに検討した。奇形腫成分は腫瘍の57.8%に認められた。奇形腫陽性群では病期I腫瘍の割合が奇形腫陰性群より低かった。奇形腫陽性群では、血行性転移よりもリンパ節転移が多く認められた。奇形腫陽性群の転移病期における腫瘍マーカーの反応はきわめて良好であった。放射線学的反応が良好でなくとも、大半の患者は化学療法後の救援手術後に無病生存していた。また、純粋奇形腫で再発した2例は多角的治療で良好に治療された。奇形腫陽性群では病期I例が少ないことを考慮すると、同群全体のきわめて良好な反応は、腫瘍全体としての侵襲性の低さを示している。
